quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton explains why he ranks Michael Jordan as his GOAT
quotes.excerpt: Michael Jordan is my GOAT. My opinion is my opinion. My top five are these guys right here.
quotes.quote: I don't put LeBron in my top five or I don't put LeBron as my GOAT, that I'm hating on LeBron. I've never said anything negative or hating towards LeBron. LeBron is a friend, but my opinion is Michael Jordan is my GOAT. My opinion is my opinion. My top five are these guys right here. That's my opinion. There's nothing against him, there's nothing against his career. He's done way more on and off the court than anybody has ever done. He's played the longest in the NBA than anybody has ever done. He's got so many records in the NBA. He is one of the greatest players to ever play this game. I'm saying all of that. We do a list again in three years, my list is going to be the same. It's not going to change for me. And that's what I want everybody to understand. There's no hate. This is my opinion. Your opinion may be LeBron is your GOAT. I'm not coming at you saying, oh shit, that's you hating, Ray. I mean, you hating, whoever your fucking name is. Nah. My opinion is Michael Jordan is my GOAT. My opinion is my top five are these guys right here. That's my opinion.

quotes.quote: I'm always going to give a guy flowers. LeBron James has been top of the top since I've known him since high school, and he stayed there throughout his whole entire career. Facts. LeBron James gets a lot of -- he don't -- he don't -- he's not feared because he's nice. He's not feared because he always does things the right way. And I hate that it's a knock on him, and it's really not a knock because the man is still fucking one of the best ever to play the game, and in some people's eyes, he's the GOAT. Just, you know, not mine, or other people said as well. But what I'm saying is LeBron James has done something that you probably can say everybody's top five, everybody's top 10, everybody's top 75 list is not done. What he's done for the game on and off the court, what he's done for himself on and off the court, what he's done with this type of level of pressure, nobody's ever done. I don't even think MJ has done that. Now, don't get me wrong, MJ lived up to his hype when he came in the league, he was killing, but he didn't win. LeBron James has won since he stepped foot on the floor in basketball.
